chapter: Armstrong band memories, Chicago players and Baltimore
title: Armstrong's repertoire in 1933
summary: Budd lists the old tunes Louis played with the band, such as 'Ding Dong Daddy' and 'High Society'.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I want to ask you a couple of things about some of the songs (unintelligible) when you mentioned "Shine".
Did he play "Beau Koo Jack" in those days?

"Beau Koo Jack", yeah, "Ding Dong Daddy", "Mahogany Hall Stomp", you know. All of those. And, he -- he used to play "Ding Dong Daddy" then like I've never heard. "Big Butter and Egg Man". And, of course, we played all of our recordings, "World on a String", and all that stuff. But, he would go back and get some of those old ones. We used to play "High Society". And, where all of the clarinets had to play that solo.
